prompt_text: Who is the best property management company in St. Louis MO for a rental home?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” company, but **Avenue Residential Leasing** looks like a strong first choice to interview for a St. Louis rental home. Its published services include 24/7 maintenance response, local insured vendors, and no maintenance markup. It lists management at **5%–10% of monthly rent** (with a $100 minimum), plus a separate tenant-placement fee of **50%–100% of one month’s rent**. [Services](https://propertymanagementstl.com/services/property-management/) · [Pricing](https://www.avenuestl.com/st-louis-property-management-pricing)

Also compare **Homestretch Property Management**, which has positive owner testimonials about communication and handling leasing and day-to-day management. [Website](https://homestretchpropertymanagement.com/)

Before choosing, ask each for a sample owner statement and a written fee schedule, and clarify maintenance approval limits, inspection frequency, lease-up costs, and how quickly they respond to owner questions. The best fit can depend on your home’s location and whether you value lower fees, hands-on maintenance, or frequent reporting.
